title: Inverse-image class of matched cycles under normalized additive etale edges
statement: Let g:Y→X be a morphism of quasi-compact separated schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Let U,V be finite affine-intersection covers with V-tuples contained in the g-preimages of U-tuples. Fix n≥0 and additive equivalences a,a_prime from cohomology of the fixed lifted additive structure sheaves [def-sc-etale-additive-structure-restriction] to ordinary unit Cech homology [lem-pc-flat-cech-base-change], both augmentation-normalized [def-pbc-etale-additive-cech-normalization]. Let z,z_prime be any supplied Cech cycles whose every target coordinate is the structural pullback of the source coordinate, then restricted along the tuple inclusion. Then [z_prime]=a_prime(H^n(q_g)(g_H^*(a^(-1)([z])))), where q_g is the adjoint of etaleAdditiveSheafToLowerStar [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. This asserts neither existence of comparisons nor existence of cycles nor scalar compatibility.

source.place: Theorem 59.22.4, separated affine-cover proof; Tag 01EQ, augmentation construction; Tag 01FD, Lemma 20.15.1, commuting augmented double-complex diagram. Worker-written explicit normalization of this argument.

proof.text: Choose source and target injective resolutions and canonical comparisons. Apply coefficient cycle realization to z, obtaining s,t_alpha,t_beta with equal total classes. Source normalization ha gives a(c_X([s]))=[z]; applying a inverse identifies c_X([s]) with a inverse([z]).

Apply augmentation transfer to the supplied matched cycles and the source equality, obtaining s_prime and target augmentation cycles with equal classes and the canonical cohomology value. Apply ha_prime to the target witnesses, substitute the transfer value and the source identification, and reverse the resulting equality.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 20.15.1, reduced to source augmentation realization and transport of a supplied augmentation equality. Original theorem signature unchanged; combination proof compiled against the shared library.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleAdditiveCech_normalized_inverseImage
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X)
    [CompactSpace X] [CompactSpace Y] [X.IsSeparated] [Y.IsSeparated]
    {ι : Type u} [Finite ι] (U : ι → X.Opens) (V : ι → Y.Opens)
    (hU : ∀ (k : ℕ) (y : Fin (k + 1) → ι), IsAffineOpen (⨅ l, U (y l)))
    (hV : ∀ (k : ℕ) (y : Fin (k + 1) → ι), IsAffineOpen (⨅ l, V (y l)))
    (hcover : iSup U = ⊤) (hcover' : iSup V = ⊤)
    (hinter : ∀ (k : ℕ) (y : Fin (k + 1) → ι),
      (⨅ l, V (y l)) ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ (⨅ l, U (y l)))
    (n : ℕ)
    (a : Sheaf.H X.etaleAdditiveSheaf n ≃+
      (cechOver X.toSpecΓ U (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).homology n)
    (ha : IsEtaleAdditiveCechNormalized U n a)
    (a' : Sheaf.H Y.etaleAdditiveSheaf n ≃+
      (cechOver Y.toSpecΓ V (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf)).homology n)
    (ha' : IsEtaleAdditiveCechNormalized V n a')
    (z : (cechOver X.toSpecΓ U (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).cycles n)
    (z' : (cechOver Y.toSpecΓ V (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf)).cycles n)
    (hcoords : ∀ y : Fin (n + 1) → ι,
            cechCoordinate Y.toSpecΓ V (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf) n y
                ((cechOver Y.toSpecΓ V (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf)).iCycles n z') =
              (show Y.Modules from SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf).presheaf.map
                (homOfLE (hinter n y)).op
                ((SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit g.toRingCatSheafHom).val.app
                  (op (⨅ l, U (y l)))
                  (cechCoordinate X.toSpecΓ U (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) n y
                    ((cechOver X.toSpecΓ U
                      (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).iCycles n z)))) :
    (cechOver Y.toSpecΓ V (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf)).homologyπ n z' =
      a' (Sheaf.H.map
        (((Etale.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction _ g).homEquiv _ _).symm
          (Scheme.etaleAdditiveSheafToLowerStar g)) n
        (Etale.cohomologyMap g X.etaleAdditiveSheaf n
          (a.symm ((cechOver X.toSpecΓ U
            (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).homologyπ n z))))
